description: Everything about one control by its slug: what it does, its control type, license and repository, the current release's properties, and download links for its solutions. Use it once search or list_components has given you a slug; use get_doc_page for installation and configuration instructions, which this does not return. An unknown slug, or a version the control never released, returns an error naming the tool to call instead. include_versions and include_related each cost an extra query, so leave them off unless you need the release history or similar controls.

include_related.description: Also return similar controls. Costs an extra query; leave off unless needed.

include_versions.description: Also return every release. Costs an extra query; leave off unless needed.

version.description: A specific release. Defaults to the latest stable one.

name: get_component

builtWith.description: ai where an AI assistant wrote the code, ai-assisted where a person wrote it with one. Null where the author has not said.

controlTypeDescription.description: What that control type means, in a sentence.

currentVersion.description: The release described, or null where nothing has been published yet.

framework.description: How the control is built, e.g. "react_virtual".

properties.description: Every property the control exposes, including the columns a dataset control binds.

kind.description: input, output, dataset, dataset_column or feature.

name.description: The property's logical name, as bound in the maker.

usage.description: input, output or bound. Null on a feature.

downloads.description: Empty where the control has no published release.

requiresEntitlement.description: True where the file is paid for and the download needs an entitlement.

url.description: Absolute URL of the counted download route. Use this rather than any storage URL.

hosts.description: Where this control runs: canvas apps, model-driven apps, or both.

isArchived.description: True when the control is no longer maintained.

summaryMd.description: The author's longer description, as Markdown.

supportLevel.description: maintained, or reference: a worked example not maintained for production. Null where the author has not said.

supportUrl.description: Where to report a problem with the control.

url.description: Absolute URL of the control's page, for citing.

title: Get a PCF control
